picks.editorial_note: A $38M ARPA-H award — the largest research grant in UVM's history — to build AI 'digital twins' of critically ill patients represents a major bet on AI-personalized critical care medicine.

picks.editorial_note: Georgia Tech and Amazon's new joint Science Hub formalizes a decade-long relationship into a dedicated research pipeline on autonomy and AI, signaling deepening big-tech investment in university research infrastructure.
picks.title: Georgia Tech and Amazon Launch Joint Science Hub

picks.editorial_note: UNSW students partnering with Commonwealth Bank to prototype fraud detection tackles a problem that cost Australians $2.18 billion in 2025, showing direct industry-academia translation of AI research into financial harm reduction.
picks.title: The CBA partnership giving students the chance to solve a $2.18 billion problem

picks.title: WashU-led team wins $4M DARPA grant to improve fuel injector design

picks.editorial_note: Cambridge's open-source Tessera model mapping smallholder crops in Senegal with less compute than existing tools is a concrete, real-world AI application with direct relevance to global food security.
picks.title: AI tool for mapping smallholder crops proves itself in Senegal
